title: Loaded Pulled Pork Totchos
description: Crispy potato nuggets are loaded with barbequed pulled pork, Cheddar cheese sauce, and pinto beans in these totchos perfect for tailgating.
ingredients: 1 (28 ounce) package frozen bite-size potato nuggets (such as Tater Tots®)
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 cup chopped roasted red bell peppers

steps.text: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). Spread potato nuggets on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake in the preheated oven until browned and crisp, 20 to 25 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl; season lightly with salt.
Mix pulled pork and barbeque sauce together in a bowl until pork is evenly coated.
Whisk sour cream and smoked paprika together in a small bowl.

Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour until a paste forms, 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in milk until no lumps remain. Cook and stir until sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat; whisk in Cheddar cheese until melted. Season sauce with salt and pepper.
Drizzle Cheddar cheese sauce over potato nuggets. Cover with pulled pork mixture and dollops of sour cream. Top with pinto beans, roasted peppers, green onion, and thyme.

video.description: Party food will never be the same after you try these totally loaded tots! And you’ll love them even more when you discover how easy they are to assemble! Bake up your tater tots so they’re irresistibly crisp, then make your toppings: mix pulled pork with barbecue sauce, mix sour cream with smoked paprika, and make a cheese sauce with butter, flour, milk, salt, pepper, and Cheddar cheese. Top your tots with cheese sauce, pulled pork and sour cream. Then overload with pinto beans, roasted peppers, green onion and minced fresh thyme. Don’t forget some cold beer to wash it all down!
